weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). Neutralizes "effective against dragons" bonuses. Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range. If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP ≥ 75% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit during combat. If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Spd. Restores HP = 30% of damage dealt.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+7 during combat.

b.d: If foe initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's first attack by 10% during combat, and also, if unit's Atk > foe's Res, unit's first attack deals damage = 10% of unit's Atk minus foe's Res during combat.

If foe initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's first attack by 15% during combat, and also, if unit's Atk > foe's Res, unit's first attack deals damage = 15% of unit's Atk minus foe's Res during combat.

If foe initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's first attack by 20% during combat, and also, if unit's Atk > foe's Res, unit's first attack deals damage = 20% of unit's Atk minus foe's Res during combat.

c.d: Inflicts Atk/Spd-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
